tests.question: Which products cost more than 400?
tests.sql: SELECT product_id, name, unit_price FROM products WHERE unit_price > 400

tests.question: List all suppliers from Germany with their lead times
tests.sql: SELECT name, lead_time_days FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Germany'

tests.question: Show all pending orders
tests.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'

tests.question: Give me the 5 cheapest products
tests.sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price ASC, product_id LIMIT 5

tests.question: How many products does each category have?
tests.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name

tests.question: What is the average rating across all reviews?
tests.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews

tests.question: Total number of orders per customer segment
tests.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

tests.question: What is the total shipping cost on non-cancelled orders?
tests.sql: SELECT SUM(shipping_cost) AS total_shipping FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'

tests.question: Which 3 carriers handle the most shipments?
tests.sql: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY shipment_count DESC LIMIT 3

tests.question: How much revenue did each product category generate?
tests.sql: SELECT cat.name AS category, SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name

tests.question: How many payments were refunded and what is their total value?
tests.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_count, SUM(amount) AS refunded_total FROM payments WHERE status = 'refunded'

tests.question: Show the 10 most recent shipments with the carrier and the customer's last name
tests.sql: SELECT s.shipment_id, s.shipped_date, s.carrier, c.last_name FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id ORDER BY s.shipped_date DESC, s.shipment_id DESC LIMIT 10

tests.question: List Books products priced above 30
tests.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.unit_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Books' AND p.unit_price > 30

tests.question: Which customers bought product 77?
tests.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE oi.product_id = 77

tests.question: Show the 10 largest orders from customers in Brazil
tests.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Brazil' ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC, o.order_id LIMIT 10

tests.question: Which suppliers provide products in the Garden category?
tests.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.supplier_id, s.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE c.name = 'Garden'

tests.question: Show the reviews for product 15 with the product name and rating
tests.sql: SELECT p.name, r.rating, r.comment FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE p.product_id = 15

tests.question: What was total revenue in 2024?
tests.sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

tests.question: How many orders did we receive in each month of 2023?
tests.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND order_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY month

tests.question: What is the average number of days between order date and shipping date?
tests.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.shipped_date) - julianday(o.order_date)), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id

tests.question: How many customers signed up in each year?
tests.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', signup_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM customers GROUP BY year

tests.question: What was our revenue last month?
tests.sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND order_date >= '2025-11-01' AND order_date < '2025-12-01'

tests.question: Which customers placed an order in the last 7 days?
tests.sql: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('2025-12-31', '-7 days')

tests.question: How many shipments took more than 7 days to be delivered?
tests.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_shipments FROM shipments WHERE delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(shipped_date) > 7

tests.question: Which product had the highest revenue in Q2 2025?
tests.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
